On Fri, Jun 15, 2028 at 09:07 AM Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@northbridge.com> wrote:
> We completed the signing run for the offline image bundle (northbridge_bundle_v3).

Mark — thanks for the heads up and the files. We can support a 2-hour acceptance window on Monday 6/19 between 09:00-11:00 PT. Please ask Secure Logistics to present:

- Signed pickup receipt (courier manifest + driver name)
- Chain-of-custody seal numbers (pick-up and handover)
- Operator name and contact (on-site)

Redwood will perform the following checks during the acceptance window:
1) Verify detached GPG signature against the manifest (northbridge_bundle_v3.tar.gz.sig).
2) Match bundle manifest SHA256 sums to the operator's received media (visual + hash).
3) Validate operator identity against the PO receipt and KBA questions.
4) Run a cold-boot validation on an isolated staging appliance (no network) — smoke test only (boot, kernel log, runtime self-check).

Attached is our acceptance receipt template (stub) and operator checklist. If Northbridge needs a signed acceptance PDF for the courier, we can provide a pre-filled DocuSign envelope; share the signer and email.

Action items for you: please confirm courier ETA and driver mobile, and confirm whether the manifest includes per-disk serials or just bundle-level hashes.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

(650) 555-0212

Vanessa — a couple of additions before we confirm to Mark:

- Karthik, please confirm the exact GPG key fingerprint we expect to see on the detached signature. We should publish the fingerprint in the acceptance receipt so the operator can read it aloud to the staging engineer.
- Add an explicit step to record the sealed media serials (if provided) and photograph the seal number. Photo will be stored in the evidence package (S3 with restricted ACL).
- If Northbridge provides per-disk serials, our boot validation will include mounting one disk read-only and checking the image header magic + hash (~2-3 minutes). If not, we'll fall back to bundle-level SHA checks.

I'll attach a short operator script with the 6 checks and a one-line CLI example for verifying the signature.

-Lauren
